title: Bruno Mars · I Just Might
description: Curved mahogany 1970s disco studio, concentric glowing circular ceiling lights in amber, rainbow, blue and crimson red, all-Bruno mint-green leisure-suit funk band, DJ turntable booth, trio close-up and carpet-lounge pose.
